answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 5527 Country: India Title: Can You Please tell about Performing Namaz behind Ahle Hadith and Barelwi ? Whether We can Offer Namaz behind them? As there are Only Barelwi Maskids in Our Locality. Question: Can You Please tell about Performing Namaz behind Ahle Hadith and Barelwi ? Whether We can Offer Namaz behind them? As there are Only Barelwi Maskids in Our Locality. Answer ID: 5527 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 710/589=B) If there are two three people of our maslak then it is better to pray with jamat separately and avoid praying with them. In case of compulsion, you may pray behind them as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
